_comment: Offline trilingual lesson corpus for the leave-behind village tutor. Keywords match the learner's question; answers teach in English, Swahili (sw), and Spanish (es). No internet needed.

entries.en: Hello! In Swahili say 'Jambo' or 'Habari'. In Spanish say 'Hola'.
entries.sw: Jambo! Kwa Kiingereza ni 'Hello'. Kwa Kihispania ni 'Hola'.
entries.es: Hola! En ingles es 'Hello'. En suajili es 'Jambo'.

entries.en: To ask a name: English 'What is your name?', Swahili 'Jina lako ni nani?', Spanish 'Como te llamas?'.
entries.sw: Kuuliza jina: Kiingereza 'What is your name?', Kihispania 'Como te llamas?'.
entries.es: Para preguntar el nombre: Ingles 'What is your name?', Suajili 'Jina lako ni nani?'.

entries.en: 1-5: one, two, three, four, five. Swahili: moja, mbili, tatu, nne, tano. Spanish: uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco.
entries.sw: 1-5: moja, mbili, tatu, nne, tano. Kiingereza: one..five. Kihispania: uno..cinco.
entries.es: 1-5: uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco. Ingles: one..five. Suajili: moja..tano.

entries.en: Days start the week: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday. Swahili: Jumatatu, Jumanne, Jumatano.
entries.sw: Siku za wiki: Jumatatu, Jumanne, Jumatano. Kiingereza: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday.
entries.es: Dias de la semana: lunes, martes, miercoles. Ingles: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday.

entries.en: Colors: red, blue, green. Swahili: nyekundu, bluu, kijani. Spanish: rojo, azul, verde.
entries.sw: Rangi: nyekundu, bluu, kijani. Kiingereza: red, blue, green.
entries.es: Colores: rojo, azul, verde. Ingles: red, blue, green.

entries.en: Addition combines amounts. 3 + 4 = 7. Type a sum like '8 + 5' and I will solve it.
entries.sw: Kujumlisha ni kuunganisha. 3 + 4 = 7. Andika '8 + 5' nami nitakokotoa.
entries.es: Sumar combina cantidades. 3 + 4 = 7. Escribe '8 + 5' y lo resuelvo.

entries.en: Multiplication is repeated addition. 3 x 4 = 12. Try typing '6 x 7'.
entries.sw: Kuzidisha ni kujumlisha mara kwa mara. 3 x 4 = 12. Jaribu '6 x 7'.
entries.es: Multiplicar es sumar repetido. 3 x 4 = 12. Prueba '6 x 7'.

entries.en: Wash hands with soap for 20 seconds before eating and after the toilet. It stops disease.
entries.sw: Osha mikono kwa sabuni sekunde 20 kabla ya kula na baada ya choo. Inazuia magonjwa.
entries.es: Lavate las manos con jabon 20 segundos antes de comer y despues del bano. Evita enfermedades.

entries.en: Make water safe by boiling for 1 minute, or filtering, or using the school's UV system on solar power.
entries.sw: Fanya maji salama kwa kuchemsha dakika 1, au kuchuja, au kutumia mfumo wa UV wa shule kwa nishati ya jua.
entries.es: Haz el agua segura hirviendo 1 minuto, filtrando, o con el sistema UV de la escuela con energia solar.

entries.en: Sleep under a treated net, remove standing water, and see a clinic if fever and chills start.
entries.sw: Lala chini ya chandarua, ondoa maji yaliyotuama, na nenda kliniki ukianza homa na baridi.
entries.es: Duerme bajo un mosquitero tratado, elimina agua estancada, y ve a la clinica si hay fiebre.

entries.en: Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity. Batteries store it for night. Your school runs on this.
entries.sw: Paneli za jua hubadilisha mwanga wa jua kuwa umeme. Betri huhifadhi kwa usiku. Shule yenu inatumia hii.
entries.es: Los paneles solares convierten la luz en electricidad. Las baterias la guardan para la noche.

entries.en: Read a little every day. Sound out each letter, then blend them. Practice beats talent.
entries.sw: Soma kidogo kila siku. Tamka kila herufi, kisha unganisha. Mazoezi yanashinda kipaji.
entries.es: Lee un poco cada dia. Pronuncia cada letra, luego unelas. La practica supera al talento.

entries.en: Hard is not impossible. Try once more, ask a question, and rest. Your brain grows when it struggles.
entries.sw: Ngumu si haiwezekani. Jaribu tena, uliza swali, na pumzika. Ubongo wako hukua unapojitahidi.
entries.es: Dificil no es imposible. Intenta otra vez, haz una pregunta, y descansa. El cerebro crece al esforzarse.
